description: This file defines the interface for the libparodus library, including data structures, error codes, and function prototypes for initializing, sending, receiving, and shutting down the libparodus connection to the parodus service.

methods.name: libparodus_init
methods.description: Initializes the libparodus connection with provided configuration.

methods.name: libparodus_receive
methods.description: Receives the next message sent to the service, with a timeout.

methods.name: libparodus_close_receiver
methods.description: Sends a close message to the receiver.

methods.name: libparodus_send
methods.description: Sends a WRP message to the parodus service.

methods.name: libparodus_strerror
methods.description: Returns the string description of a libparodus error code.
